observations.behavior: Removes a conditional block that previously checked cachedFailure and incremented dnsNegativeCacheCounter, while retaining the unconditional negative cache set and unconditional deletion of the cache key. Also removes several comments.
observations.posthog_connection: This could affect DNS resolution caching and negative caching behavior in the Node.js shared utilities, potentially changing how transient DNS failures are recorded and cached. The removal of the cachedFailure-dependent counter and conditional deletion could alter the accounting of shadow hits and cache cleanup, though the unconditional negative cache set and deletion remain.
